name: Slack cable to open tentacle retention channel

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the octopus body footprint on the desk-support plane
coordinate_frame.y_positive: toward the rear of the body

datums.description: channel mouth pinch plane between the two compliant detent lips

allowed: cable slides along the channel axis
cable lifts out through the channel mouth under deliberate hand force
constrained: cable falling out under its own weight

assembly.direction: press the slack cable down through the channel mouth by hand
assembly.contact_mode: open compliant pinch, no clamping and no strain relief
assembly.sequence_notes: Cables are routed after the body is placed. The channel never carries cable tension.

dimensions.feature: intended cable outer-diameter design range, no cable measured

environment_and_variation.environment: dry adult indoor desk or shelf, room temperature, no power delivery under load
uncontrolled: actual cable outer diameter and jacket hardness
PETG channel-lip stiffness at the released wall thickness
print-direction anisotropy at the detent lips

keepouts_and_access: Do not claim strain relief, minimum bend radius, insulation or EMC function.
Do not route mains cables or cables carrying power-delivery heat under load.
Keep the channel mouth reachable by one adult finger without tools.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The channel sizes are declared design intent carried from the research row. No real cable was measured, no jacket hardness is recorded and no retention force is known. This is the weakest evidence link in the product and it caps project readiness at R2.

failure_modes.mode: The channel mouth is wider than the cable and the cable falls out under its own weight.
failure_modes.effect: The organizer does not organize; the desk returns to a tangle.
failure_modes.mitigation: Measure real cables, size the pinch gap below the measured minimum outer diameter, verify with a coupon.

failure_modes.mode: The channel mouth is too tight and the cable jacket is scuffed or deformed on insertion.
failure_modes.effect: Cosmetic jacket damage and a poor tactile impression.
failure_modes.mitigation: Radius the detent lips, keep the pinch compliant, run a 100-cycle insertion test.

acceptance_criteria: Each declared channel retains its intended cable against a 2 N vertical tug without the cable leaving the channel.
Insertion needs no tool and leaves no visible jacket deformation after 100 insertion cycles.
